text:
arun: Draft RN for late-night rollout: runtime v2.4.0 (small opt + bug fixes). Change window: 01:00 PT -> 02:00 PT. Highlights: 
1) fix for batching hang when client cancels quickly
2) improved Dedicated pool drain behavior (reduces reconnects)
3) KV cache init race guard
Please review RN copy, confirm canary cadence, and agree on rollback pin duration. I want the internal brief ready by 00:40 PT.

sam-ops: I'll own deploy. Proposed canary: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% with 8m holds at first two steps, 12m at 50%. Health checks: error-rate <1.5%, p95 <750ms, no new alerts from svc-metrics. Rollback triggers: sustained errors >=1.5% for 4m OR p95 >850ms for 8m OR any new infra PagerDuty. If rollback: pin to v2.3.9 for 60m. OK?

jen: RN microcopy ready. Under "Known impacts" I added: "Small number of Dedicated customers may see a brief reconnect during pool drain; no requests lost." Also added changelog link.

tom: Infra prefers a 30m pin normally, but given this touches drain behavior, +60m pin sounds reasonable. One ask: add an explicit step in rollback guidance to run `cache-invalidate` if we see persistent KV misses.

marta: Adding runbook link: https://intra.redwood/runbooks/runtime-deploy. I'll paste the paging list in the doc: @oncall-runtime, @infra-ops, @eng-runtime. Also suggest we disable non-critical background jobs for the 1h window to reduce noise.

sam-ops: Deploy command I'll run after staging smoke:

```
/deploy service=runtime version=v2.4.0 canary=2% step=8m health=svc-metrics-check
```

Manual increments at each hold. Abort syntax: `deploybot cancel 1769997777`. Rollback (manual):

```
deploybot rollback --service runtime --to-version v2.3.9 --reason "canary fail"
routing pin runtime v2.3.9 --duration 60m
```

deploybot: deploy queued by sam-ops. Staging smoke passed at 23:58 PT. Canary plan loaded: 2% -> 10% -> 50% -> 100%. To cancel: `deploybot cancel 1769997777`. I will ping this thread for each step and post metric snapshots.

arun: Communications plan: 00:40 PT staff brief (ops + eng leads), 00:50 PT internal blast (all-eng), 01:00 PT start deploy. We'll mention the brief in the announcement and the evacuation cue in case of rollback >15m.

sam-ops: One more ops note: during the 50% hold I'll run a quick synthetic smoke across EU region to catch any region-specific regressions. If that fails we abort.

jen: RN updated with evacuation language: "If we need to rollback and customer impact exceeds 15 minutes we'll send a targeted status update."

tom: Infra checklist added to RN doc. Also adding `cache-invalidate` step under troubleshooting.

marta: Done on runbook and paging. I'll also schedule @eng-runtime for standby from 00:30 -> 02:00 PT.

arun: Great. Final check: agree on rollback thresholds and 60m pin?

sam-ops: Confirmed.

jen: Confirmed.

tom: Confirmed.

marta: Confirmed.

sam-ops: I'll kick at 01:00 PT unless I get a hold. Deploybot will post progress and metric snapshots here. :rocket:

arun: Thanks all — cutting staff brief at 00:40 PT.
